title: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP
description: The official Model Context Protocol adapter for Folklore by Helena Bioinformatics. It provides automated ACMG/AMP germline variant classification and assessment, criterion-level evidence, provenance, literature and ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity assertions. Gene tools resolve identities and return source-qualified immutable profiles and live literature captures. This distribution contains the MCP adapter and public API clients.
